about.title: About Taylor Accounting Services
text: After years of preparing taxes and spotting far too many subpar financial reports, Taylor Rhodes knew there was a better way. She founded Taylor Accounting Services, LLC to fill a critical gap: providing small businesses with top-tier financial management, which in turn frees up valuable time for CPAs to focus on tax returns.

"Over the years, I noticed a real shortage of quality bookkeepers," Taylor explains. "I’d look at messy financial reports and think, there has to be an easier way for business owners to access someone who actually knows how to keep books. With the current boom in startups and entrepreneurs, accurate books and timely tax filing are more critical than ever."

Taylor understands that when it comes to business operations, one size never fits all. That is why she has expanded her practice beyond traditional bookkeeping to offer total business solutions. To fully protect and scale your enterprise, Taylor Accounting Services now provides comprehensive business evaluations and tailored commercial insurance solutions, ensuring every angle of your operation is secure and optimized for growth.
